content.text: Hi! I'm Lingling. What's your name?
content.translation: 嗨！我是玲玲。你叫什么名字？

content.text: Hello! My name is Amy.
content.translation: 你好！我叫 Amy。

content.text: I'm Sam.
content.translation: 我是 Sam。

content.text: I'm Daming.
content.translation: 我是大明。

content.text: I'm Bobo.
content.translation: 我是 Bobo。

content.text: Goodbye, Bobo. Have a nice day!
content.translation: 再见，Bobo。祝你今天愉快！

content.text: Goodbye, Lingling!
content.translation: 再见，玲玲！

content.text: Good morning! I'm Ms Smart.
content.translation: 早上好！我是 Smart 老师。

content.text: Good morning, Ms Smart.
content.translation: 早上好，Smart 老师。

content.text: Hi, new friends! Do they have a good day?
content.translation: 嗨，新朋友们！他们今天过得愉快吗？

content.text: Hi, everyone! I'm Sam. I'm nine.
content.translation: 嗨，大家好！我是 Sam。我九岁。

content.text: She's Amy. She's nine, too. We're from the UK. We're twins!
content.translation: 她是 Amy。她也是九岁。我们来自英国。我们是双胞胎！

content.text: I'm Daming. He's Lingling.
content.translation: 我是大明。他是玲玲。

content.text: Hi, Sam. Hi, Amy. I'm Lingling. He's Daming. Come and play!
content.translation: 嗨，Sam。嗨，Amy。我是玲玲。他是大明。一起来玩吧！

content.text: Hi, I'm Mia.
content.translation: 嗨，我是 Mia。

content.text: He's David.
content.translation: 他是 David。

content.text: Hi, I'm Ben.
content.translation: 嗨，我是 Ben。

content.text: I'm nine, too. Let's play together!
content.translation: 我也九岁。让我们一起玩吧！

content.text: OK! Great!
content.translation: 好！太棒了！

content.text: Oh, no! My kite is in the tree.
content.translation: 噢，不！我的风筝在树上。

content.text: Let's help!
content.translation: 让我们来帮忙！

content.text: Here you are.
content.translation: 给你。

content.text: Thank you.
content.translation: 谢谢。

content.text: What a nice school! Look, Mum. It's my schoolbag.
content.translation: 好漂亮的学校！看，妈妈。这是我的书包。

content.text: What's in it?
content.translation: 里面有什么？

content.text: A book, a pen, a pencil, a ruler, an eraser and a pencil case.
content.translation: 一本书、一支钢笔、一支铅笔、一把尺子、一块橡皮和一个铅笔盒。

content.text: Take care of your school things.
content.translation: 要保管好你的学习用品。

content.text: Bye, kids.
content.translation: 再见，孩子们。

content.text: Bye, Ms Olivia.
content.translation: 再见，Olivia 老师。

content.text: What's this? Oh, it's a pen. What's this? It's a ruler. What's that? It's an eraser.
content.translation: 这是什么？噢，是一支钢笔。这是什么？是一把尺子。那是什么？是一块橡皮。

content.text: Whose pen is this? Is this your pen, Yoyo?
content.translation: 这是谁的钢笔？这是你的钢笔吗，Yoyo？

content.text: Yes, it is. Thank you.
content.translation: 是的，是我的。谢谢。

content.text: Is this your ruler, Lulu?
content.translation: 这是你的尺子吗，Lulu？

content.text: No, it isn't.
content.translation: 不，不是我的。

content.text: It's my ruler.
content.translation: 这是我的尺子。

content.text: It's my eraser.
content.translation: 这是我的橡皮。

content.text: Take care of your school things.
content.translation: 保管好你们的学习用品。

content.text: What do you want?
content.translation: 你想要什么？

content.text: I want a balloon!
content.translation: 我想要一个气球！

content.text: What colour is it? Can you guess?
content.translation: 是什么颜色的？你能猜吗？

content.text: It's blue!
content.translation: 是蓝色的！

content.text: Yes! Here you are.
content.translation: 好！给你。

content.text: I want a balloon, too.
content.translation: 我也想要一个气球。

content.text: What colour is it?
content.translation: 是什么颜色的？

content.text: It's red!
content.translation: 是红色的！

content.text: Bobo! Come back!
content.translation: Bobo！回来！

Unit 3 It's a colourful world!.unit: Unit 3 It's a colourful world! (Speed up)

content.text: What's this?
content.translation: 这是什么？

content.text: It's a pencil box. It's red.
content.translation: 是一个铅笔盒。是红色的。

content.text: What's this? What colour is it?
content.translation: 这是什么？是什么颜色？

content.text: It's an umbrella. It's pink.
content.translation: 是一把伞。是粉色的。

content.text: What's this? What colour is it?
content.translation: 这是什么？是什么颜色？

content.text: It's a school bag. It's green.
content.translation: 是一个书包。是绿色的。

content.text: What's that? What colour is it?
content.translation: 那是什么？是什么颜色？

content.text: It's a ruler. It's yellow.
content.translation: 是一把尺子。是黄色的。

content.text: The rainbow is colourful.
content.translation: 彩虹是五彩缤纷的。

content.text: Wow! What is it?
content.translation: 哇！这是什么？

content.text: This is a Chinese knot. It's beautiful.
content.translation: 这是一个中国结。它很漂亮。

content.text: How many ropes?
content.translation: 有多少根绳子？

content.text: Guess!
content.translation: 猜猜看！

content.text: Six? Twelve? Haha, no.
content.translation: 六根？十二根？哈哈，不对。

content.text: Look! Only one rope! That's amazing!
content.translation: 看！只有一根绳子！太神奇了！

content.text: How do you make it?
content.translation: 你怎么编的？

content.text: Let me show you.
content.translation: 我教你给你看。

content.text: OK. That's great!
content.translation: 好的。太棒了！

content.text: One! Two! Three! Four! Five! Six! Seven! Eight! Nine! Ten! Eleven! Twelve! My twelve eggs!
content.translation: 一！二！三！四！五！六！七！八！九！十！十一！十二！我的十二个蛋！

content.text: Er, I'm hungry. So she goes out for food.
content.translation: 呃，我饿了。于是她出去找食物。

content.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven. Oh, no!
content.translation: 一，二，三，四，五，六，七，八，九，十，十一。噢，不！

content.text: I'm Jiajia. This is my sister. This is my dad. This is my mum. That's my grandma and that's my grandpa.
content.translation: 我是 Jiajia。这是我的妹妹/姐姐。这是我的爸爸。这是我的妈妈。那是我的奶奶/姥姥，那是我的爷爷/姥爷。

content.text: Look at the cap!
content.translation: 看那顶帽子！

content.text: Oh, no! The cap!
content.translation: 噢，不！帽子！

content.text: Come back, Lucky!
content.translation: 回来，Lucky！

content.text: Don't worry! We can help!
content.translation: 别担心！我们能帮忙！

content.text: Great!
content.translation: 太好了！

content.text: Come on, Daddy! Come on, Mummy! Come on, Brother! Let's take a photo together.
content.translation: 加油，爸爸！加油，妈妈！加油，哥哥！让我们一起拍张照片。

content.text: Oh, where's the dog? It's in the orange box! Come here, dear little dog. Let's take a photo together.
content.translation: 噢，狗在哪里？它在橙色盒子里！过来，亲爱的小狗。让我们一起拍张照片。

content.text: Dad, where's Susu?
content.translation: 爸爸，Susu 在哪儿？

content.text: She's in the living room. On the chair, I think.
content.translation: 她在客厅。我想在椅子上。

content.text: Susu is not here.
content.translation: Susu 不在这里。

content.text: Mum, where's Susu?
content.translation: 妈妈，Susu 在哪儿？

content.text: Look in the bedroom. She's under the bed.
content.translation: 在卧室里看看。她在床下。

content.text: Susu's toy is here. But where is she?
content.translation: Susu 的玩具在这里。但她在哪儿呢？

content.text: Susu?
content.translation: Susu？

content.text: Miaow...
Oh! Susu is in the box with four little babies!
content.translation: 噢！Susu 在盒子里，跟四只小宝宝在一起！

content.text: Dad's in the kitchen. Cooking is fun.
content.translation: 爸爸在厨房。做饭很有趣。

content.text: Mum's in the living room. She loves the sun.
content.translation: 妈妈在客厅。她喜欢阳光。

content.text: Brother's in the bedroom. He likes to run.
content.translation: 哥哥在卧室。他喜欢跑来跑去。

content.text: This is our home. Lucky, lucky us!
content.translation: 这是我们的家。我们真幸福！

content.text: Let's go to the zoo.
content.translation: 我们去动物园吧。

content.text: Look! What are they?
content.translation: 看！它们是什么？

content.text: They are pandas.
content.translation: 它们是熊猫。

content.text: They are cute. Can they move?
content.translation: 它们真可爱。它们会动吗？

content.text: Yes, they can.
content.translation: 是的，它们会。

content.text: The giraffes are tall. The monkeys are brown. They are strong.
content.translation: 长颈鹿很高。猴子是棕色的。它们很强壮。

content.text: Look at the elephant! It's big. Look at the tiger! It's strong.
content.translation: 看那只大象！它很大。看那只老虎！它很强壮。

content.text: Touch your head. Touch your face. Touch your nose.
content.translation: 摸摸你的头。摸摸你的脸。摸摸你的鼻子。

content.text: My head, my face, my nose.
content.translation: 我的头，我的脸，我的鼻子。

content.text: Touch your ears. Touch your mouth. Touch your eyes.
content.translation: 摸摸你的耳朵。摸摸你的嘴巴。摸摸你的眼睛。

content.text: My ears, my mouth, my eyes.
content.translation: 我的耳朵，我的嘴巴，我的眼睛。

content.text: This is my arm. This is my hand. This is my leg. This is my foot.
content.translation: 这是我的胳膊。这是我的手。这是我的腿。这是我的脚。

content.text: Wave your arms. Clap your hands. Stamp your foot.
content.translation: 挥挥你的胳膊。拍拍你的手。跺跺你的脚。

content.text: What's your favourite food?
content.translation: 你最喜欢什么食物？

content.text: I like noodles. They're yummy.
content.translation: 我喜欢面条。它们很好吃。

content.text: What about you, Amy?
content.translation: 你呢，Amy？

content.text: I like rice. It's yummy, too.
content.translation: 我喜欢米饭。它也很好吃。

content.text: I like meat. I don't like fish.
content.translation: 我喜欢肉。我不喜欢鱼。

content.text: I like vegetables. I don't like candy.
content.translation: 我喜欢蔬菜。我不喜欢糖果。

content.text: What's your hobby?
content.translation: 你的爱好是什么？

content.text: I like reading. I like reading books.
content.translation: 我喜欢阅读。我喜欢读书。

content.text: I like singing. I like singing songs.
content.translation: 我喜欢唱歌。我喜欢唱歌。

content.text: I like drawing. I like drawing pictures.
content.translation: 我喜欢画画。我喜欢画图画。

content.text: I like dancing. I like dancing to music.
content.translation: 我喜欢跳舞。我喜欢跟着音乐跳舞。

content.text: I like playing. I like playing games.
content.translation: 我喜欢玩。我喜欢玩游戏。

content.text: What time is it?
content.translation: 几点了？

content.text: It's seven o'clock. It's time to get up.
content.translation: 七点了。该起床了。

content.text: It's eight o'clock. It's time for school.
content.translation: 八点了。该上学了。

Unit 5 What time is it?.unit: Unit 5 What time is it? (Speed up)

content.text: It's twelve o'clock. It's time for lunch.
content.translation: 十二点了。该吃午饭了。

content.text: It's nine o'clock. It's time for bed.
content.translation: 九点了。该睡觉了。

content.text: What day is it today?
content.translation: 今天星期几？

content.text: It's Monday. I go to school on Mondays.
content.translation: 今天星期一。我星期一去上学。

content.text: It's Saturday. I play football on Saturdays.
content.translation: 今天星期六。我星期六踢足球。

content.text: I go to the park on Sundays.
content.translation: 我星期天去公园。

content.text: I read books on Fridays.
content.translation: 我星期五读书。

content.text: Can you jump high, Daming?
content.translation: 大明，你能跳得高吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我能。

content.text: Can you run fast, Sam?
content.translation: 萨姆，你能跑得快吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我能。

content.text: Can you play ping-pong, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，你会打乒乓球吗？

content.text: Yes, I can.
content.translation: 是的，我会。

content.text: Can you swim, Daming?
content.translation: 大明，你会游泳吗？

content.text: No, I can't. But I can learn.
content.translation: 不，我不会。但是我可以学。

content.text: I can swim now!
content.translation: 我现在会游泳啦！

content.text: Wow! You can swim fast!
content.translation: 哇！你游得真快！

content.text: This is Terry Fox. He lost one leg because of cancer.
content.translation: 这是特里·福克斯。他因为癌症失去了一条腿。

content.text: He ran across Canada to get money for the people with cancer.
content.translation: 他跑遍加拿大为癌症患者筹钱。

content.text: It's OK to fail. Don't give up!
content.translation: 失败没关系。不要放弃！

content.text: Never stop! Work hard and try your best!
content.translation: 永不停止！努力工作，尽你最大的努力！

content.text: Dad, may I play outside?
content.translation: 爸爸，我可以出去玩吗？

content.text: Yes. But can you tidy your room first?
content.translation: 可以。但是你能先整理你的房间吗？

content.text: Bobby, can you help me clean the floor?
content.translation: 波比，你能帮我擦地板吗？

content.text: OK. That's easy.
content.translation: 好的。那很容易。

content.text: Go, Bobby! Good job!
content.translation: 加油，波比！干得好！

content.text: Sam, are you still busy?
content.translation: 萨姆，你还在忙吗？

content.text: Yes, Dad. I need to clean the floor, the desk and the wall.
content.translation: 是的，爸爸。我需要擦地板、书桌和墙。

content.text: Bobby, stop! Look! It's so dirty now!
content.translation: 波比，停下！看！现在它好脏啊！

content.text: Phew! So much work! Let's work together.
content.translation: 唷！好多活儿啊！让我们一起干吧。

content.text: Wash the dishes. Feed the dog. Make the beds. Wash the clothes.
content.translation: 洗碗。喂狗。铺床。洗衣服。

content.text: Sweep the floor. Take out the rubbish.
content.translation: 扫地。倒垃圾。

content.text: Everyone, well done! Chores can be fun!
content.translation: 大家干得好！家务也可以很有趣！

Unit 3 What's the weather like?.unit: Unit 3 What's the weather like? (Start up)

content.text: What's the weather like?
content.translation: 天气怎么样？

content.text: It's sunny and warm. We can go out to play.
content.translation: 晴朗又暖和。我们可以出去玩。

content.text: Oh, it's cool!
content.translation: 哦，好凉快！

content.text: It's windy and cloudy. Let's go home!
content.translation: 又刮风又阴天。我们回家吧！

content.text: Oh! It's rainy now. Let's run!
content.translation: 哦！现在下雨了。我们快跑！

content.text: Look! I've got a good idea.
content.translation: 看！我有个好主意。

content.text: Our umbrellas are great!
content.translation: 我们的雨伞太棒了！

content.text: The sun comes up... It's sunny.
content.translation: 太阳升起来了……天晴了。

content.text: The clouds go by... It's cloudy.
content.translation: 云飘过去了……天阴了。

content.text: The wind blows around... It's windy.
content.translation: 风吹来吹去……起风了。

content.text: The rain comes down... It's rainy.
content.translation: 雨落下来了……下雨了。

content.text: The snow dances around... It's snowy.
content.translation: 雪飞舞着……下雪了。

content.text: In any weather, we have fun. Hot, cold, cool or warm. Enjoy them all!
content.translation: 无论什么天气，我们都开心。热、冷、凉、暖，全都享受！

content.text: I'm Li Han. This is my apple tree.
content.translation: 我是李涵。这是我的苹果树。

content.text: I'm ten now. The tree is ten, too. Spring is here! The birds are back.
content.translation: 我现在十岁了。这棵树也十岁了。春天来了！鸟儿回来了。

content.text: It's summer. The apple tree is like a sun umbrella. I like reading under it.
content.translation: 夏天到了。苹果树像一把太阳伞。我喜欢在树下读书。

content.text: It's autumn. I like autumn best! There are many red apples on the tree!
content.translation: 秋天到了。我最喜欢秋天！树上有很多红苹果！

content.text: Can I share the apples with my friends? Sure!
content.translation: 我能和朋友们分享这些苹果吗？当然！

content.text: It's winter. My apple tree has warm, new clothes.
content.translation: 冬天到了。我的苹果树穿上了暖和的新衣服。

content.text: A snowstorm comes. Oh, no! My apple tree! I don't like winter!
content.translation: 暴风雪来了。哦，不！我的苹果树！我不喜欢冬天！

content.text: Don't worry. Let's wait for spring.
content.translation: 别担心。让我们等待春天。

content.text: It's spring again. My apple tree grows again. Hooray!
content.translation: 春天又来了。我的苹果树又生长了。万岁！

content.text: Let's go for a picnic in the park.
content.translation: 我们去公园野餐吧。

content.text: Hooray!
content.translation: 万岁！

content.text: How do we get there?
content.translation: 我们怎么到那里？

content.text: Let's go by car! It's fast!
content.translation: 我们开车去吧！很快！

content.text: No, let's go in a "green" way!
content.translation: 不，让我们用“绿色”的方式去！

content.text: A green way?
content.translation: 绿色的方式？

content.text: Yes. Go and get ready. Let's meet in five minutes.
content.translation: 是的。去准备吧。我们五分钟后见。

content.text: We're green now! Let's go!
content.translation: 我们现在是绿色的了！出发！

content.text: Ha ha! Not that kind of green!
content.translation: 哈哈！不是那种绿色！

content.text: This kind of green!
content.translation: 是这种绿色！

content.text: We can go by bus, going up and down.
content.translation: 我们可以坐公交车，上上下下。

content.text: We can go by car, to get around.
content.translation: 我们可以坐汽车，四处逛逛。

content.text: We can go by train, from city to town.
content.translation: 我们可以坐火车，从城市到小镇。

content.text: We can go by ship, across the sea.
content.translation: 我们可以坐大船，横跨大海。

content.text: We can go by plane, high up in the sky.
content.translation: 我们可以坐飞机，高高飞在天上。

content.text: We can go to different places, near and far.
content.translation: 我们可以去不同的地方，或近或远。

content.text: My cat Susu goes out every morning! Where does she go?
content.translation: 我的猫苏苏每天早上都出去！她去哪儿？

content.text: Where does she go? I don't know! Let's find out tomorrow.
content.translation: 她去哪儿？我不知道！我们明天去查个明白。

content.text: Susu goes straight on to the museum. She turns left there.
content.translation: 苏苏直着走到博物馆。她在那里左转。

content.text: At the hospital, she turns right.
content.translation: 在医院那里，她右转。

content.text: Then Susu stops. Let's go there!
content.translation: 然后苏苏停下了。我们去那儿吧！

content.text: Go straight on to the museum. Then turn left.
content.translation: 直着走到博物馆。然后左转。

content.text: Turn right at the hospital.
content.translation: 在医院那里右转。

content.text: The wheels on the bus go round and round.
content.translation: 公交车的轮子转啊转。

content.text: Turn left and go straight on. Ding! Ding! Ding! Here's the library.
content.translation: 左转再直走。叮！叮！叮！这里是图书馆。

content.text: The wheels on the bus go round and round.
content.translation: 公交车的轮子转啊转。

content.text: Turn right and go straight on. Ding! Ding! Ding! Here's the sports centre.
content.translation: 右转再直走。叮！叮！叮！这里是体育中心。

content.text: Who's the man?
content.translation: 这个男人是谁？

content.text: This is my father.
content.translation: 这是我的爸爸。

content.text: What does he do? Have a guess!
content.translation: 他是做什么的？猜一猜！

content.text: Is he a farmer?
content.translation: 他是农民吗？

content.text: No, he isn't. But he often works in the fields.
content.translation: 不，他不是。但他经常在田里工作。

content.text: Is he a painter?
content.translation: 他是画家吗？

content.text: No, he isn't. But he uses his brush a lot.
content.translation: 不，他不是。但他经常用画笔。

content.text: I know! He's a scientist!
content.translation: 我知道了！他是科学家！

content.text: That's right!
content.translation: 没错！

content.text: Oh, look at this!
content.translation: 哦，看这个！

content.text: At night, many people are still working.
content.translation: 夜晚，很多人还在工作。

content.text: The bus driver drives the bus.
content.translation: 公交车司机开着公交车。

content.text: The taxi driver drives the taxi.
content.translation: 出租车司机开着出租车。

content.text: The police officer keeps us safe.
content.translation: 警察保护我们的安全。

content.text: The doctor helps sick people.
content.translation: 医生帮助病人。

content.text: The nurse looks after patients.
content.translation: 护士照顾病人。

content.text: They are night owls.
content.translation: 他们是夜猫子。

Unit 2 How do you feel today.unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today (Start up)

content.text: It's my first Beijing opera show with Lingling. I'm so excited.
content.translation: 这是我和玲玲第一次参加京剧表演。我太兴奋了。

content.text: Lingling, it's Amy's mum. Amy is ill today.
content.translation: 玲玲，是艾米的妈妈。艾米今天病了。

content.text: Is she coughing?
content.translation: 她在咳嗽吗？

content.text: Yes, she is. She can't talk.
content.translation: 是的。她不能说话。

content.text: She can't take part in the show today. She's sad.
content.translation: 她今天不能参加演出了。她很难过。

content.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
content.translation: 听到这个我很难过。

content.text: Dear Amy, Get well soon. Don't be sad. We can do it next time.
content.translation: 亲爱的艾米，早日康复。别难过。我们下次再表演。

content.text: Dear Lingling, Thank you. I'm feeling better now.
content.translation: 亲爱的玲玲，谢谢你。我现在好多了。

content.text: Time for the show. I'm happy!
content.translation: 演出时间到了。我很开心！

Unit 2 How do you feel today.unit: Unit 2 How do you feel today (Speed up)

content.text: Jay gets a ship model for his birthday.
content.translation: 杰伊生日收到一个船模型。

content.text: Jay is surprised and happy.
content.translation: 杰伊又惊又喜。

content.text: Ray breaks the model.
content.translation: 雷弄坏了模型。

content.text: Jay is angry. He is shouting at Ray.
content.translation: 杰伊很生气。他在对雷大喊。

content.text: Jay runs back to his room. He is sad.
content.translation: 杰伊跑回房间。他很难过。

content.text: They say sorry and make the model together.
content.translation: 他们互相道歉，一起重做模型。

content.text: They are happy again.
content.translation: 他们又开心了。

content.text: It's the school dance show. Lingling is in it.
content.translation: 这是学校舞蹈比赛。玲玲参加了。

content.text: What are you looking at?
content.translation: 你在看什么？

content.text: I'm looking at their clothes.
content.translation: 我在看他们的衣服。

content.text: Are you worried?
content.translation: 你担心吗？

content.text: Yes. Everyone's wearing beautiful clothes. But I'm not. I can't win.
content.translation: 是的。每个人都穿着漂亮的衣服。但我没有。我赢不了。

content.text: Don't worry about your clothes. Just go and dance.
content.translation: 别担心你的衣服。去跳舞吧。

content.text: OK.
content.translation: 好的。

content.text: Lingling is dancing well.
content.translation: 玲玲跳得很好。

content.text: The best dancer is... Lingling! Hooray!
content.translation: 最佳舞者是……玲玲！万岁！

content.text: Little Chicken is sad. He is not good at anything.
content.translation: 小鸡很难过。他什么都不擅长。

content.text: Bird, can you teach me to fly?
content.translation: 小鸟，你能教我飞吗？

content.text: Oh, Duck, please teach me to swim.
content.translation: 哦，鸭子，请教我游泳。

content.text: Little Chicken can't fly or swim.
content.translation: 小鸡不会飞也不会游。

content.text: One day, he sings. Everyone loves his song.
content.translation: 有一天，他唱歌。大家都喜欢他的歌。

content.text: Hard work makes me shine!
content.translation: 努力使我闪闪发光！

content.text: Everyone's got talent!
content.translation: 每个人都有才能！

content.text: We're making a small garden for the class!
content.translation: 我们在为班级建一个小花园！

content.text: We're digging.
content.translation: 我们在挖土。

content.text: I've got tomato seeds.
content.translation: 我有西红柿种子。

content.text: I've got bean seeds.
content.translation: 我有豆子种子。

content.text: I've got cucumber seeds.
content.translation: 我有黄瓜种子。

content.text: I've got sunflower seeds.
content.translation: 我有葵花籽。

content.text: Are your seeds growing?
content.translation: 你的种子在发芽吗？

content.text: Yes, they are. Look!
content.translation: 是的，看！

content.text: Are your seeds growing, Sam?
content.translation: 萨姆，你的种子在发芽吗？

content.text: No, they aren't. Why aren't my seeds growing?
content.translation: 不，没有。为什么我的种子不发芽？

content.text: Oh, Sam. These seeds can't grow!
content.translation: 哦，萨姆。这些种子不能发芽！

content.text: Why?
content.translation: 为什么？

content.text: Because your seeds are from a snack bag.
content.translation: 因为你的种子来自零食袋。

content.text: Let me plant a new one.
content.translation: 让我种一颗新的。

content.text: This is Huahua's grandpa. He is a scientist.
content.translation: 这是花花的爷爷。他是一位科学家。

content.text: Grandpa often works in the fields.
content.translation: 爷爷经常在田里工作。

content.text: I want to grow tall rice plants.
content.translation: 我想种高大的水稻。

content.text: Grandpa works hard day and night.
content.translation: 爷爷夜以继日地努力工作。

content.text: I think his dreams will come true.
content.translation: 我想他的梦想会实现。

content.text: Lingling, what do you want to wear to the party?
content.translation: 玲玲，你想穿什么去聚会？

content.text: My favourite blue dress!
content.translation: 我最喜欢的蓝色连衣裙！

content.text: What are you doing, Mum?
content.translation: 妈妈，你在干什么？

content.text: I'm looking for your blue dress.
content.translation: 我在找你的蓝裙子。

content.text: It's too small! I'm sad.
content.translation: 它太小了！我很难过。

content.text: I have an idea.
content.translation: 我有个主意。

content.text: Mum cuts up the dress and makes new clothes.
content.translation: 妈妈剪开裙子做新衣服。

content.text: I'm wearing it at the party!
content.translation: 我在聚会上穿上它了！

content.text: I'm happy now!
content.translation: 我现在很开心！

content.text: Police officers wear blue shirts.
content.translation: 警察穿蓝衬衫。

content.text: Doctors and nurses wear white robes.
content.translation: 医生和护士穿白袍。

content.text: Firemen wear orange uniforms.
content.translation: 消防员穿橙色制服。

content.text: Students wear school uniforms.
content.translation: 学生穿校服。

content.text: These are my works for the Art Festival.
content.translation: 这些是我为艺术节准备的作品。

content.text: Look! That's a cow. There are horns on it.
content.translation: 看！那是一头牛。上面有角。

content.text: That's rain. Those are raindrops.
content.translation: 那是雨。那些是雨点。

content.text: Are you drawing?
content.translation: 你在画画吗？

content.text: No, I'm writing Chinese words.
content.translation: 不，我在写汉字。

content.text: Are there more?
content.translation: 还有更多吗？

content.text: Yes, there are.
content.translation: 是的，有。

content.text: Weiwei and Lanlan are on a field trip.
content.translation: 薇薇和兰兰在户外研学。

content.text: They find a baby bird falls off the tree.
content.translation: 他们发现一只小鸟从树上掉下来。

content.text: Look! A baby bird!
content.translation: 看！一只小鸟！

content.text: Can we help it?
content.translation: 我们能帮助它吗？

content.text: Yes, we can. Let's call the forest keeper.
content.translation: 是的，我们能。我们打电话给护林员吧。

content.text: The forest keeper comes and helps the bird.
content.translation: 护林员来帮助小鸟。

content.text: The bird is safe now.
content.translation: 小鸟现在安全了。

Unit 1 What's on your plate?.unit: Unit 1 What's on your plate? (Start up)

content.text: Wow! There is so much food.
content.translation: 哇！有这么多食物。

content.text: What do you want to eat?
content.translation: 你想吃什么？

content.text: I want noodles in soup, salad and beef.
content.translation: 我想要汤面、沙拉和牛肉。

content.text: I want chicken and beef.
content.translation: 我想要鸡肉和牛肉。

content.text: I want an apple and milk, too!
content.translation: 我还想要一个苹果和牛奶！

content.text: I like cake and cola.
content.translation: 我喜欢蛋糕和可乐。

content.text: Don't take too much! We should eat all the food on our plates.
content.translation: 不要拿太多！我们应该把盘子里的食物都吃完。

content.text: Sam, look at your plate. You should have some vegetables.
content.translation: 萨姆，看看你的盘子。你应该吃点蔬菜。

content.text: OK. Let me go and get some.
content.translation: 好的，我去拿一些。

content.text: What vegetables have you got now?
content.translation: 你现在拿了什么蔬菜？

content.text: Potatoes, a lot of potatoes.
content.translation: 土豆，很多土豆。

content.text: Oh, Sam!!! Those are chips!
content.translation: 哦，萨姆！！！那些是薯条！

Unit 1 What's on your plate?.unit: Unit 1 What's on your plate? (Speed up)

content.text: A letter from your stomach.
content.translation: 一封来自你胃的信。

content.text: Every morning, you need a good breakfast.
content.translation: 每天早上，你都需要一顿丰盛的早餐。

content.text: Just a few biscuits are not enough!
content.translation: 只吃几块饼干是不够的！

content.text: I often feel hungry all morning.
content.translation: 我整个上午经常觉得饿。

content.text: Then you usually eat too much for lunch.
content.translation: 然后你午餐通常吃得太多。

content.text: You often have a lot of meat, but no vegetables and no fruit.
content.translation: 你经常吃很多肉，但不吃蔬菜和水果。

content.text: This makes you sleepy in the afternoon.
content.translation: 这会让你下午犯困。

content.text: And you always eat dinner too quickly so you can go and play.
content.translation: 而且你总是为了去玩而吃得太快。

content.text: I have to work hard for a long time after dinner.
content.translation: 晚饭后我得长时间辛苦工作。

content.text: Sally, please change your bad eating habits.
content.translation: 萨莉，请改掉你的坏习惯。

content.text: Help me stay healthy. Then you are healthy, too.
content.translation: 帮我保持健康，这样你也会健康。

content.text: The dress is too small for you, Amy.
content.translation: 艾米，这条裙子对你来说太小了。

content.text: Mum, don't throw it away. I can make use of it.
content.translation: 妈妈，别扔掉它。我可以利用它。

content.text: OK. Take it. But what for?
content.translation: 好的，拿去吧。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: Grandpa, give those cans to me, please.
content.translation: 爷爷，请把那些罐子给我。

content.text: Sure, but what for?
content.translation: 当然可以，但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: Don't throw away that box, Dad! I want to use it.
content.translation: 爸爸，别扔掉那个盒子！我想用它。

content.text: OK, you can keep it. But what for?
content.translation: 好的，你可以留着。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: Grandma, give that old shirt to me, please.
content.translation: 奶奶，请把旧衬衫给我。

content.text: No problem. But what for?
content.translation: 没问题。但是用来做什么？

content.text: Wait and see!
content.translation: 等着瞧吧！

content.text: These are houses for birds. They're also places to keep them warm.
content.translation: 这些是鸟的房子。它们也是给鸟儿保暖的地方。

content.text: I love it! Now they have a better home!
content.translation: 我太喜欢了！现在它们有了更好的家！

content.text: Dear all,
content.translation: 亲爱的大家：

content.text: Winter is coming, so we made these houses for birds.
content.translation: 冬天要来了，所以我们为鸟儿做了这些房子。

content.text: They keep the birds safe and warm.
content.translation: 它们让鸟儿安全又温暖。

content.text: Please don't take them away. Let's be kind to the birds.
content.translation: 请不要把它们拿走。让我们善待鸟儿。

content.text: We're making more houses because lots of birds need a home.
content.translation: 我们正在做更多房子，因为很多鸟儿需要家。

content.text: Don't throw cans, boxes, bottles or old clothes away. Give them to us.
content.translation: 不要把罐子、盒子、瓶子或旧衣服扔掉。把它们给我们吧。

content.text: It can help a lot! Thank you so much!
content.translation: 这能帮上大忙！非常感谢你们！

content.text: For Duoduo, Tutu is his best and only friend.
content.translation: 对多多来说，图图是他最好、也是唯一的朋友。

content.text: He wants to play with Tutu, but Tutu is playing with two other boys.
content.translation: 他想和图图一起玩，但图图正和另外两个男孩玩。

content.text: This makes Duoduo unhappy.
content.translation: 这让多多不开心。

content.text: Tutu asks Duoduo to join them but Duoduo just walks away.
content.translation: 图图叫多多一起玩，但多多只是走开了。

content.text: After a week, Duoduo feels sad and he misses Tutu.
content.translation: 一周后，多多感到难过，他很想念图图。

content.text: But Tutu may not miss me because he has new friends.
content.translation: 但是图图可能不想我，因为他有了新朋友。

content.text: Hi Duoduo. How are you?
content.translation: 嗨，多多。你好吗？

content.text: I'm unhappy because I'm not your friend now.
content.translation: 我不开心，因为我现在不是你的朋友了。

content.text: Yes, I have new friends, but you're still my friend.
content.translation: 是的，我有新朋友，但你仍然是我的朋友。

content.text: Old friends and new friends are both very nice. Join us and they can be your friends, too.
content.translation: 老朋友和新朋友都很好。加入我们吧，他们也会成为你的朋友。

content.text: Now Duoduo has three best friends!
content.translation: 现在多多有了三个最好的朋友！

content.text: You can't be friends with Dog because you're so different.
content.translation: 你不能和狗狗做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

content.text: You can't be friends with Bird because you're so different.
content.translation: 你不能和小鸟做朋友，因为你们太不一样了。

content.text: Let's show them we aren't different. Then we can be friends.
content.translation: 让我们证明我们并没有不同。那样我们就能做朋友了。

content.text: Good idea!
content.translation: 好主意！

content.text: I am small and you are big. I eat seeds and you eat meat. I fly and you run.
content.translation: 我小你大。我吃种子你吃肉。我飞你跑。

content.text: Er, what do we share?
content.translation: 呃，我们有什么共同的？

content.text: We want to be friends but we can't. We are so different.
content.translation: 我们想成为朋友，但做不到。我们太不一样了。

content.text: But we are friends because we are happy together.
content.translation: 但我们能成为朋友，因为我们在一起很开心。

content.text: Friends play together and friends share with each other. That's the key.
content.translation: 朋友一起玩耍，朋友互相分享。这才是关键。

content.text: Let's show this to our parents. Then we can be friends — the best friends!
content.translation: 让我们把这一点展示给我们的父母。那样我们就能成为朋友——最好的朋友！

content.text: Thursday 11 October
content.translation: 10月11日 星期四

content.text: Our school's going to have a girls' basketball team. Amy and I want to join. We're going to have the test tomorrow.
content.translation: 我们学校要组建一支女子篮球队。我和艾米想加入。我们明天要参加选拔。

content.text: Friday 12 October
content.translation: 10月12日 星期五

content.text: Amy is in. But I am out. I am very sad.
content.translation: 艾米入选了。但我落选了。我非常难过。

content.text: Sunday 14 October
content.translation: 10月14日 星期日

content.text: Amy is so kind. She comes to play basketball with me. I'm going to work hard. I can make it next time.
content.translation: 艾米真好。她来和我一起打篮球。我要努力。下次我一定能成功。

content.text: Friday 26 October
content.translation: 10月26日 星期五

content.text: There's going to be a test again. I'm still not sure. But I'm going to try again.
content.translation: 又要选拔了。我仍然没有把握。但我要再试一次。

content.text: Sunday 28 October
content.translation: 10月28日 星期日

content.text: I'm in! I'm so happy. I'm going to play with Amy and my other friends!
content.translation: 我入选了！我好开心。我要和艾米以及其他朋友一起打球了！

content.text: Ben makes a four-week plan to get better.
content.translation: 本制定了一个为期四周的计划来让自己变得更好。

content.text: Week 1: He's going to eat healthily.
content.translation: 第一周：他打算吃得健康。

content.text: Week 2: He's going to do more exercise.
content.translation: 第二周：他打算做更多运动。

content.text: Week 3: He's going to tidy his room by himself.
content.translation: 第三周：他打算自己整理房间。

content.text: Week 4: He's going to read more books.
content.translation: 第四周：他打算读更多书。

content.text: After a month, Ben finishes all the tasks. He feels good, so he decides to continue.
content.translation: 一个月后，本完成了所有任务。他感觉很好，所以决定继续。

content.text: He's going to start a new four-week plan.
content.translation: 他打算开始一个新的四周计划。

Unit 5 Look into the future.unit: Unit 5 Look into the future (Start up)

content.text: What is Dad making?
content.translation: 爸爸在做什么？

content.text: I am making a robot. I still need some time to get it to work. It will help people a lot.
content.translation: 我在做一个机器人。我还需要一些时间让它运转起来。它会帮人们很多忙。

content.text: What will it do for people?
content.translation: 它会为人们做什么？

content.text: A lot of things.
content.translation: 很多事。

content.text: Will it do our chores?
content.translation: 它会做我们的家务吗？

content.text: Yes, it will. We will have more free time.
content.translation: 是的，会的。我们会有更多空闲时间。

content.text: Great. Will it take care of pets?
content.translation: 太好了。它会照顾宠物吗？

content.text: Yes, it will. It will keep an eye on the pets all day.
content.translation: 是的，会的。它会整天照看宠物。

content.text: Will it play with us?
content.translation: 它会和我们一起玩吗？

content.text: Yes, it will know all kinds of games and sports.
content.translation: 会的，它懂各种游戏和运动。

content.text: Then we'll have a lot of fun. Well... will it do my homework?
content.translation: 那我们会玩得很开心。嗯……它会做我的作业吗？

content.text: No, it won't!
content.translation: 不，不会！

Unit 5 Look into the future.unit: Unit 5 Look into the future (Speed up)

content.text: Where will people live in the future?
content.translation: 未来人们会住在哪里？

content.text: People will live on the moon.
content.translation: 人们会住在月球上。

content.text: We will travel to Mars in 2080.
content.translation: 2080年我们会去火星旅行。

content.text: The city will be under the sea.
content.translation: 城市会建在海底。

content.text: The future of our city is bright.
content.translation: 我们城市的未来是光明的。

content.text: We will use 3-D printing to make food.
content.translation: 我们会用3D打印来做食物。

content.text: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. Let's make mooncakes for the animals at the zoo!
content.translation: 中秋节要来了。我们给动物园的动物做月饼吧！

content.text: OK! Great idea!
content.translation: 好的！好主意！

content.text: Hello, children! What are you going to make?
content.translation: 孩子们，你们好！你们打算做什么？

content.text: I'm going to make meat mooncakes for the tigers.
content.translation: 我要给老虎做肉馅月饼。

content.text: I'm going to make bamboo mooncakes for the pandas.
content.translation: 我要给熊猫做竹子馅月饼。

content.text: How about you, Amy?
content.translation: 你呢，艾米？

content.text: I'm going to make carrot mooncakes for the rabbits.
content.translation: 我要给兔子做胡萝卜馅月饼。

content.text: Are you going to make flower mooncakes for the giraffes?
content.translation: 你要给长颈鹿做花馅月饼吗？

content.text: They won't eat meat mooncakes. They will be very big!
content.translation: 它们不吃肉馅月饼。月饼会很大的！

content.text: What do you do at the Spring Festival?
content.translation: 你在春节做什么？

content.text: We eat dumplings and visit our relatives.
content.translation: 我们吃饺子、走亲访友。

content.text: What do you do at the Dragon Boat Festival?
content.translation: 你在端午节做什么？

content.text: People will have dragon boat races.
content.translation: 人们会举行龙舟比赛。

content.text: What do you do at the Lantern Festival?
content.translation: 你在元宵节做什么？

content.text: We put up lanterns and watch the lion dance.
content.translation: 我们挂灯笼、看舞狮。

Module 1.unit: Module 1 Unit 1 We lived in a small house.

content.text: What's this, Lingling?
content.translation: 这是什么，玲玲？

content.text: It's a programme about China. An old lady is talking about her life many years ago.
content.translation: 这是一个关于中国的节目。一位老奶奶正在讲她许多年前的生活。

content.text: Many years ago, we lived in a small house. We didn't have enough food.
content.translation: 许多年前，我们住在一所小房子里。我们没有足够的食物。

content.text: There weren't many buses. There weren't any televisions.
content.translation: 那时没有很多公交车，也没有电视机。

content.text: What about now?
content.translation: 那现在呢？

content.text: Now we live in a big house. We've got lots of food.
content.translation: 现在我们住在一所大房子里，有充足的食物。

content.text: There are lots of buses and cars. I watch TV every day.
content.translation: 现在有很多公交车和小汽车。我每天都看电视。

content.text: China is changing. Life is getting better and better!
content.translation: 中国正在变化，生活越来越好！

Module 1.unit: Module 1 Unit 2 She didn't have a television.

content.text: Grandma, tell me about your life many years ago.
content.translation: 奶奶，给我讲讲您许多年前的生活吧。

content.text: I was a young girl then. I lived in a small village.
content.translation: 那时我还是个小姑娘，住在一个小村子里。

content.text: I didn't have a television, a radio or a telephone.
content.translation: 我那时没有电视机，没有收音机，也没有电话。

content.text: What did you do then?
content.translation: 那时您做什么呢？

content.text: I cooked on a fire. I worked in the fields.
content.translation: 我在炉火上做饭，在地里干活。

content.text: Now I've got a television, a telephone and a computer. Life is very different now.
content.translation: 现在我有电视机、电话和电脑了。现在的生活大不一样了。

content.text: I see. Life was very different in China many years ago.
content.translation: 我明白了。许多年前中国的生活和现在大不相同。

content.text: Who's this, Lingling?
content.translation: 这是谁，玲玲？

content.text: It's my grandma. She was a dancer many years ago.
content.translation: 这是我的奶奶。许多年前她是一名舞蹈演员。

content.text: Where did she dance?
content.translation: 她在哪里跳舞？

content.text: She danced in lots of Chinese cities.
content.translation: 她在中国的很多城市跳过舞。

content.text: Did she learn any foreign languages?
content.translation: 她学过外语吗？

content.text: Yes, she did. She learnt English. These are her English books.
content.translation: 是的，她学过英语。这些是她的英语书。

content.text: Your grandma is great!
content.translation: 你的奶奶真了不起！

content.text: Yes, she is. She's still learning English now!
content.translation: 是啊，她现在还在学英语呢！

Module 2.unit: Module 2 Unit 2 Mr Li was a teacher.

content.text: Look at this photo, Lingling. Who's this old man?
content.translation: 看这张照片，玲玲。这位老爷爷是谁？

content.text: That's Mr Li. Ten years ago, he was a teacher. He taught Chinese.
content.translation: 那是李先生。十年前他是一名老师，教语文。

content.text: Chen Hai was in his class. He was a good pupil. He studied very hard.
content.translation: 陈海在他班上。他是个好学生，学习非常努力。

content.text: What does Mr Li do now?
content.translation: 李先生现在是做什么的？

content.text: Now Mr Li doesn't work. Chen Hai is an English teacher.
content.translation: 现在李先生不工作了。陈海是一名英语老师。

content.text: And Chen Hai is teaching Mr Li English now!
content.translation: 现在陈海在教李先生英语呢！

content.text: Wow! How interesting!
content.translation: 哇！太有趣了！

content.text: Look, Sam. I've got an email from Lingling. It's about English food.
content.translation: 看，萨姆。我收到了玲玲的一封电子邮件，是关于英国食物的。

content.text: She had eggs and sausages for breakfast. She had sandwiches for lunch.
content.translation: 她早餐吃了鸡蛋和香肠，午餐吃了三明治。

content.text: What did she have for dinner?
content.translation: 她晚餐吃了什么？

content.text: She had fish and chips. It's a traditional English dish.
content.translation: 她吃了炸鱼薯条，那是一道传统的英国菜。

content.text: Does she like English food?
content.translation: 她喜欢英国食物吗？

content.text: Yes, she does. She says it's delicious.
content.translation: 喜欢，她说很美味。

Module 3.unit: Module 3 Unit 2 Sam ate four hamburgers.

content.text: Sam ate four hamburgers at school today!
content.translation: 萨姆今天在学校吃了四个汉堡！

content.text: Four hamburgers! He really likes hamburgers.
content.translation: 四个汉堡！他太喜欢汉堡了。

content.text: Yes, I love hamburgers very much.
content.translation: 是的，我非常爱吃汉堡。

content.text: I had a sandwich, because I don't like hamburgers.
content.translation: 我吃了一个三明治，因为我不喜欢汉堡。

content.text: What are you going to eat tonight, Lingling?
content.translation: 你今晚要吃什么，玲玲？

content.text: We're going to have Chinese food tonight. I can't wait!
content.translation: 今晚我们要吃中国菜，我等不及啦！

Module 4.unit: Module 4 Unit 1 Let's make a home library.

content.text: Let's make a home library, Dad.
content.translation: 爸爸，我们来建一个家庭图书馆吧。

content.text: Good idea! We can put the books on these shelves.
content.translation: 好主意！我们可以把书放在这些架子上。

content.text: What are these big books? They're heavy.
content.translation: 这些大大的书是什么？好重呀。

content.text: They're dictionaries. Let's put them on this shelf.
content.translation: 它们是词典。我们把它们放在这个架子上吧。

content.text: These are books about China. Let's put them on shelf B.
content.translation: 这些是关于中国的书。我们把它们放在 B 架上。

content.text: And these books are about computers. Let's put them on shelf C.
content.translation: 这些是关于电脑的书。我们把它们放在 C 架上。

content.text: Now our home library is ready. You can borrow books from it!
content.translation: 我们的家庭图书馆建好啦。你们可以从这里借书！

content.text: Great! Thank you, Amy.
content.translation: 太棒了！谢谢你，埃米。

Module 4.unit: Module 4 Unit 2 We can find information from books and CDs.

content.text: We're going to do a science project about animals.
content.translation: 我们要做一个关于动物的科学项目。

content.text: Where can we find information?
content.translation: 我们去哪里查找资料呢？

content.text: We can find information from books and CDs.
content.translation: 我们可以从书籍和光盘里查找资料。

content.text: We can also find information on the Internet.
content.translation: 我们还可以在网上查找资料。

content.text: There are lots of books in the library, too.
content.translation: 图书馆里也有很多书。

content.text: Good. Let's find information about animals together!
content.translation: 很好。我们一起去查找关于动物的资料吧！

content.text: Ms Smart, my bag is broken. I can't carry it.
content.translation: 斯玛特老师，我的书包坏了，我背不了了。

content.text: Let's buy a new bag, Lingling.
content.translation: 我们去买个新书包吧，玲玲。

content.text: This black bag is nice. It's big.
content.translation: 这个黑色的书包不错，很大。

content.text: But it's heavy. This green bag is light. And it's got two pockets.
content.translation: 但是它很重。这个绿色书包很轻，还有两个口袋。

content.text: This blue bag is big and light. And it's got four wheels.
content.translation: 这个蓝色的书包又大又轻，还有四个轮子。

content.text: Oh yes! It'll be easy for me to carry. I like it very much.
content.translation: 哦，是啊！我背着会很轻松。我非常喜欢它。

content.text: Mum, look at this white T-shirt. It's nice.
content.translation: 妈妈，看这件白色 T 恤，真好看。

content.text: But it's too big for you, Amy. Try this blue one.
content.translation: 但它对你来说太大了，埃米。试试这件蓝色的。

content.text: Oh, it's got a panda on it! How lovely!
content.translation: 哦，上面有一只熊猫！真可爱！

content.text: It's just right for you.
content.translation: 这个正适合你。

content.text: Thank you, Mum. I like this one very much.
content.translation: 谢谢妈妈。我非常喜欢这件。

Module 6.unit: Module 6 Unit 1 I went there last year.

content.text: What are you looking at, Lingling?
content.translation: 你在看什么，玲玲？

content.text: These are my photos. This is Xinjiang. I went there last year.
content.translation: 这些是我的照片。这是新疆，我去年去的。

content.text: Did you go with your parents?
content.translation: 你是和父母一起去的吗？

content.text: Yes, I did. We stayed with my grandma for a week in July.
content.translation: 是的。七月份我们在外婆家住了一个星期。

content.text: Where is Xinjiang?
content.translation: 新疆在哪里？

content.text: It's in the west of China. Hainan is in the south of China.
content.translation: 它在中国的西部。海南在中国的南部。

content.text: Xinjiang is beautiful. We had a lovely time there!
content.translation: 新疆很美，我们在那里玩得很开心！

Module 6.unit: Module 6 Unit 2 She visited the Tianchi Lake.

content.text: Look at this photo, Daming. It's the Tianchi Lake.
content.translation: 大明，看这张照片，这是天池。

content.text: Where is it?
content.translation: 它在哪里？

content.text: It's in Xinjiang. Last July I went there with my parents.
content.translation: 它在新疆。去年七月我和父母一起去的。

content.text: We rode horses and climbed the Tianshan Mountains.
content.translation: 我们骑了马，还爬了天山。

content.text: Did you visit the Tianchi Lake?
content.translation: 你们参观天池了吗？

content.text: Yes, we did. The lake is very beautiful. We had a lovely time there.
content.translation: 参观了。天池非常美，我们在那里度过了愉快的时光。

Module 7.unit: Module 7 Unit 1 My father goes to work at eight o'clock every morning.

content.text: My father goes to work at eight o'clock every morning.
content.translation: 我爸爸每天早上八点去上班。

content.text: What does he do?
content.translation: 他是做什么的？

content.text: He's a policeman. He works at a police station.
content.translation: 他是一名警察，在警察局工作。

content.text: My father goes to work at six o'clock every evening.
content.translation: 我爸爸每天傍晚六点去上班。

content.text: What does he do?
content.translation: 他是做什么的？

content.text: He's a worker. He works in a factory.
content.translation: 他是一名工人，在工厂工作。

content.text: They work hard. We love our fathers!
content.translation: 他们工作都很辛苦。我们爱爸爸们！

Module 7.unit: I'll be home at seven o'clock.

content.text: It's half past six now. Where's Dad?
content.translation: 现在六点半了，爸爸在哪里？

content.text: Don't worry. He'll be home at seven o'clock.
content.translation: 别担心，他七点会到家。

content.text: I'll be home at seven o'clock. See you then!
content.translation: 我七点到家，到时候见！

content.text: It's seven o'clock. Dad is coming home!
content.translation: 七点了，爸爸回来了！

content.text: I'm home! Sorry, I'm a little late.
content.translation: 我回来了！对不起，我晚了一点。

content.text: It's OK, Dad. Dinner is ready. Let's eat together!
content.translation: 没关系，爸爸。晚饭好了，我们一起吃吧！

Module 8.unit: Module 8 Unit 1 Will you help me?

content.text: My cousin's birthday is coming. What present can I take?
content.translation: 我表弟的生日快到了，我送他什么礼物好呢？

content.text: What about chopsticks?
content.translation: 筷子怎么样？

content.text: He's got chopsticks.
content.translation: 他已经有筷子了。

content.text: What about a kite?
content.translation: 风筝怎么样？

content.text: Good idea! I'll make a kite for him. Will you help me?
content.translation: 好主意！我要给他做一只风筝。你会帮我吗？

content.text: Of course I will. Let's draw a dragon on the paper.
content.translation: 当然会啦。我们在纸上画一条龙吧。

content.text: Thank you. I think he'll love it.
content.translation: 谢谢你。我想他一定会喜欢的。

Module 8.unit: Module 8 Unit 2 I made a kite.

content.text: What a lovely kite, Daming! Did you make it?
content.translation: 多漂亮的风筝啊，大明！是你做的吗？

content.text: Yes, I made it for my cousin.
content.translation: 是的，我为我表弟做的。

content.text: I drew a dragon on a piece of yellow paper. I painted it.
content.translation: 我在一张黄纸上画了一条龙，然后给它涂上颜色。

content.text: Then I cut the paper and put sticks on it.
content.translation: 然后我把纸剪好，绑上木棍。

content.text: I tied strings to it. Then I could fly my kite.
content.translation: 我又系上线，然后就可以放风筝了。

content.text: Your cousin will love it!
content.translation: 你的表弟一定会喜欢的！

Module 9.unit: Module 9 Unit 1 We laughed a lot.

content.text: What did you do last week, Lingling?
content.translation: 玲玲，上周你们做什么了？

content.text: We went to a children's theatre.
content.translation: 我们去了一家儿童剧院。

content.text: The men wore women's clothes. The women wore men's clothes.
content.translation: 男演员穿女装，女演员穿男装。

content.text: Did you laugh?
content.translation: 你们笑了吗？

content.text: Yes! The actors told lots of jokes. We laughed a lot.
content.translation: 笑了！演员们讲了很多笑话，我们笑得不行。

content.text: After the show, we went to a restaurant. We ate hamburgers and chips.
content.translation: 演出结束后，我们去了一家餐馆，吃了汉堡和薯条。

content.text: What a fun day!
content.translation: 多么开心的一天啊！

Module 9.unit: Module 9 Unit 2 Mum bought new T-shirts for you.

content.text: Daming, Mum bought new T-shirts for you.
content.translation: 大明，妈妈给你买了新 T 恤。

content.text: Thank you, Mum! They're nice.
content.translation: 谢谢妈妈！真好看。

content.text: Your dad bought a book about Chinese history for you, too.
content.translation: 你爸爸还给你买了一本关于中国历史的书。

content.text: Great! I love books about history.
content.translation: 太好了！我喜欢历史书。

content.text: And Dad read a book about Chinese history. He said it's interesting.
content.translation: 你爸爸读过一本中国历史的书，他说很有意思。

content.text: We'll bring them to you next week. See you soon!
content.translation: 下周我们把它们带给你。很快就能见到你啦！

Module 10.unit: Module 10 Unit 1 Where are you going?

content.text: Where are you going, Daming?
content.translation: 你要去哪里，大明？

content.text: I'm going to the airport. I'm going to America.
content.translation: 我要去机场，我要去美国了。

content.text: What are you going to take?
content.translation: 你要带些什么？

content.text: Clothes, presents, my ticket and my passport.
content.translation: 衣服、礼物、机票和护照。

content.text: When are you going to the airport?
content.translation: 你什么时候去机场？

content.text: At ten o'clock this morning. Mum is going to take me there.
content.translation: 今天上午十点，妈妈送我去。

content.text: OK. Have a safe trip! I'll miss you.
content.translation: 好，祝你一路平安！我会想你的。

Module 10.unit: Module 10 Unit 2 I'm in New York now.

content.text: Dear Mum and Dad, I'm in New York now. I got here safely.
content.translation: 亲爱的爸爸妈妈，我现在在纽约了，我平安到达了。

content.text: New York is big and beautiful. There are lots of tall buildings, cars and people.
content.translation: 纽约又大又漂亮，这里有很多高楼、汽车和行人。

content.text: Simon is American. He speaks English to me every day.
content.translation: 西蒙是美国人，他每天都和我说英语。

content.text: At first I was nervous. But now I'm all right.
content.translation: 一开始我很紧张，不过现在没事了。

content.text: I want to find out more about America. When my trip ends, I'll tell you more.
content.translation: 我想多了解一些美国。旅行结束时，我再讲给你们听。

content.text: Love, Daming.
content.translation: 爱你们的大明。
